title: Unit – 3 : Session – 10 : SLO – 2  |  Design Forms Using Labels, Text Fields, Buttons and Layout Managers
sections: 1. JLabel — a JLabel displays static text next to an input field.
2. BoxLayout — BoxLayout with Y_AXIS stacks form components vertically.
3. BorderLayout — arranges components in five regions: North, South, East, West and Center.
4. GridLayout — organizes form fields in a table-like rows-and-columns structure.
1. FALSE — JTextField is single-line only; multi-line input needs JTextArea.

2. B — frame.add(button, BorderLayout.SOUTH) places the button at the bottom region.
